settings.agents.skill.block:
You have access to a Klui board through the MCP endpoint {url}.
The key is in KLUI_AGENT_KEY: {key}

Read get_board before writing. Pass expected_updated_at when you update a card you did not just create. Never invent a board id: take it from list_boards or from the person you work with.

Prefer these tools: list_boards, get_board, create_card, bulk_create_cards, update_card, move_card, set_card_done, search_cards, get_activity. Prefer bulk_create_cards over looping create_card.
